ST-03.title: Reconcile realised P&L export against trade_plan closes
ST-03.notes: Specified (docs/specs/pnl_export_reconciliation.md) and implemented (backend/services/pnl_reconciliation_service.py) structural closure-state reconciliation between trade_history and trade_plans.status, keyed on position_id. 8 unit tests pass. Results recorded in qa_evidence_EPIC-03.md. No deviation from canonical spec (this item's own new spec) — spec_references IS the created artefact per Case B.

ST-04.title: Standardise error-response envelope across all routers
ST-04.notes: Audit of all 23 backend/routers/*.py files (79 endpoints) against canonical envelope in conventions.md §13. Findings documented in backend_engineering_patterns.md v1.2->v1.3 (§Error-response envelope conformance): dominant non-conformance is default FastAPI {detail} shape vs canonical {status, message}; most severe finding is portfolio_risk.py masking internal errors as HTTP 200 successes (violates §13.3). Non-conforming endpoints filed as follow-up backlog items BLG-BE-68 (P2) and BLG-BE-69 (P3) per AC — no router code changed, audit/documentation scope only. No deviation from canonical spec — spec_references IS the created/updated artefact per Case B (Documentation-creation). Shared-file canonical owner for backend/routers/*.py this sprint — later EPICs touching router files must rebase after this merges (sprint_backlog.md Merge Order).

ST-05.title: Build shared mock payload fixture library from openapi.yaml
ST-05.notes: Test tooling/infrastructure item (Case D). Built tests/e2e/fixtures/api-mocks.js with factories for SavedFilter/PriceAlert/BulkActionResult, derived from openapi.yaml component schemas, covering the 9 endpoints touched by BLG-SPEC-95's scope (saved-filters, price-alerts, watchlist/trade-plans bulk actions; command-palette has no backend endpoint). Documented as preferred pattern in docs/qa/playwright_coverage_matrix.md §3A (v1.2->v1.3). custom-price-alerts.spec.js refactored as working example — byte-identical mock output verified via node, all 11 scenarios re-run and passing. No deviation from canonical spec (shapes verified directly against openapi.yaml, not inferred).

ST-06.title: Audit nightly batch jobs for idempotency risk
ST-06.notes: Audited all 4 scoped jobs (positions/analyze, portfolio/snapshot, signals/generate, nightly backtest import) via direct SQL/code inspection, not docstring inference. All 4 confirmed idempotent: positions/analyze is UPDATE-only with EXIT being advisory-only (no trade_history write path); portfolio/snapshot and signals/generate both use ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (verified in database.py); backtest import uses a full transaction-scoped delete-then-reinsert (upsert_backtest_data), itself the documented fix for a prior duplication bug. Cross-references BLG-BE-59/BLG-BE-60 per AC. 0 non-idempotency risks found, 0 follow-up items needed. Noted (not actioned, out of AC scope) that 3 other nightly-job-tracked endpoints have no found cron trigger. No deviation from canonical spec (this item's own new spec) — spec_references IS the created artefact per Case B.
